name: prometheus-vscode
description: Prometheus's agent as a sidebar chat panel, driving the real @prometheus/core agent loop over your open VS Code workspace.
author: Francesco Pelizza <red-beard-phoenix@users.noreply.gitlab.com>
//main: The BUNDLED CommonJS entry, not src/. @prometheus/core is ESM-only ('type':'module') while the VS Code extension host loads extensions as CJS — esbuild.mjs bridges exactly that gap. See esbuild.mjs's header.
//activationEvents: onView keeps activation lazy (the sidebar view is the product), and onStartupFinished exists so the commands below are reachable without first opening the view.

prometheus.model.description: Model id served by `prometheus.baseUrl`. Leave empty to use the first model the endpoint actually serves.

prometheus.authLevel.description: 0 = confirm every tool call; 1 = read-only tools auto-approve. Destructive tools ALWAYS reach a human regardless.

prometheus.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions base URL. A loopback address is treated as local; anything else is treated as cloud and is subject to the cloud policy.

prometheus.contextWindow.description: The model's context window, in tokens. Sizes the tool-preamble budget — too small a value drops tool descriptions from the listing.

prometheus.apiKeyRef.description: A key REFERENCE (env:NAME or keychain ref) for the endpoint. Never the raw key.
